findings.claim: In the new Grafana list view, 'Silence notifications' is shown but clicking it does nothing: the silence drawer only mounts when rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) is true, and GrafanaRuleListItem now passes only promRule, so rule is undefined.
findings.evidence: canSilence becomes true via the prom path (useAbilities.ts:323, ORed at AlertRuleMenu.tsx:96); drawer guard at RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx:104-106 needs the ruler rule; SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer only reads grafana_alert.uid, which the prom rule's uid could supply. GrafanaGroupLoader.test.tsx asserts the item exists but never clicks it. Proposed red test: click More > Silence, expect a dialog. Reasoned, not run.
findings.reason: Two independent correctness seats, concrete code path cited; user-visible dead menu action.

findings.claim: Pause and Delete no longer appear for Grafana rules in the list view, even for users with update/delete permissions: render conditions still require rulerRule (rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule) at :123, canDelete && rulerRule at :165), which the list view no longer supplies, so the new grafanaPause/grafanaDelete abilities are computed but never used.
findings.evidence: Before the patch list items had a ruler rule and showed Pause/Delete. GrafanaGroupLoader.test.tsx grants AlertingRuleDelete + folder delete (:58) yet asserts exactly 4 menu items (:207); ui.menuItems.delete is defined but never asserted. Delete only needs identifier (showDeleteModal(identifier, groupIdentifier)); Pause needs the ruler group. Proposed red test: same test asserting the delete menu item is present. Reasoned.
findings.reason: Two correctness seats; the test locking 4 items may reflect an intentional scope cut, so confirm with the PR author, but as written permitted actions silently vanish.

findings.claim: Duplicate is wrongly enabled for non-Grafana rules: AlertRuleMenu passes skipToken for non-Grafana rules, useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(undefined) sets loading=false so MaybeSupported=AlwaysSupported, giving Duplicate=[true, hasPermission(AlertingRuleCreate)], which is ORed into canDuplicate.
findings.evidence: Users with Grafana alert.rules:create see Duplicate on Mimir/Loki/Prometheus rules, including sources without a ruler (previously hidden via isRulerAvailable=false) and users lacking AlertingRuleExternalWrite; also re-enables Duplicate for plugin-provided Grafana rules when promRule is absent. Reaches v1 RuleActionsButtons.tsx:110, rule viewer, and V2 DataSourceRuleLoader. RulesTable.test mocks useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities to [false,false], hiding it. Proposed red test: AlertRuleMenu for a cloud rule without ruler, grant AlertingRuleCreate, expect no Duplicate item. Reasoned.
findings.reason: Two correctness seats with a traced code path; fix is to return NotSupported for all actions when the prom rule is undefined/skipped.

findings.claim: Federated Mimir rule groups become editable/deletable/pausable in the v1 list and rule details: useAllAlertRuleAbilities previously computed isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group) but now delegates to useAllRulerRuleAbilities, which hardcodes isFederated = false (with a TODO).
findings.evidence: Base code at useAllAlertRuleAbilities used isFederatedRuleGroup; patched :243-245 hardcodes false. Live consumers: components/rules/RuleActionsButtons.tsx:57 (Edit), RuleDetailsButtons.tsx, GrafanaRuleQueryViewer.tsx; conflicts with RulesGroup.tsx:69 and RuleDetailsButtons.tsx:38 which still treat federated groups as read-only. Proposed red test: v1 RulesTable without the useAbilities mock, cloud rule with group.source_tenants=['t1'], AlertingRuleExternalWrite granted, expect no Edit button. Reasoned.
findings.reason: Raised by both correctness seats and passed on by both advisory seats; a behaviour regression against base with a cited source line.

findings.claim: The 'grafana' case renders <GrafanaRuleListItem> inside rules.map(...) without key={key}; the removed <GrafanaRuleLoader key={key}> had it and the sibling cases at :165/:169 still pass it.
findings.evidence: React missing-key console.error; public/test/setupTests.ts:16-21 enables jest-fail-on-console under CI, so any test rendering multiple Grafana rules here would fail; per-row state (open menu, drawers, modals) can attach to the wrong row as the paginated list grows. react/jsx-key not enabled in eslint.config.js, so lint won't catch it. Command (not run): CI=true yarn jest public/app/features/alerting/unified/rule-list/FilterView.test.tsx with a Grafana rule fixture.
findings.reason: Three seats, trivially verifiable from the diff hunk; one-token fix.

findings.claim: The rule view href drops { returnTo }, which the deleted GrafanaRuleLoader/old list item passed via createRelativeUrl(..., { returnTo }); opening a Grafana rule from the list no longer returns the user to their filtered list.
findings.evidence: Deleted GrafanaRuleLoader.tsx (patch ~line 1222) included returnTo; DataSourceRuleListItem.tsx:36-42 still sets it, so Grafana and datasource items now diverge. Proposed red test: assert the rule link href contains returnTo= in GrafanaGroupLoader.test.tsx. Reasoned.
findings.reason: All four seats; correctness seats split Important/Minor, normalised to Important as a user-visible navigation regression against base.

findings.claim: useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities gates ModifyExport, Pause, Restore and DeletePermanently on prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule, whereas the ruler path it replaces used a check covering Grafana recording rules too; Grafana recording rules lose Export (and others) in the new list. The comment at :301 ('All GrafanaPromRuleDTO rules are Grafana-managed') does not match what the code checks.
findings.evidence: Patched :301 comment vs :323-329 isAlertingRule usage; base used rulerRuleType.grafana.rule / isGrafanaManagedAlertRule. Suggested: use prometheusRuleType.grafana.rule(rule) and keep alerting-only for Silence. Reasoned.
findings.reason: Real regression against base, cheap to fix alongside the Duplicate gating fix.

findings.claim: useAllAlertRuleAbilities now calls groupIdentifier.fromCombinedRule, which calls getDatasourceAPIUid and throws 'Datasource "<name>" not found' for unregistered rule sources; the old getRulesSourceName path never threw, so a render can now crash instead of degrading.
findings.evidence: utils/datasource.ts:299-307 throw path; RuleDetails.test.tsx had to switch fixture to rulesSource: mimirDs (:36, :87) to avoid it. Seats rate production risk low since v1 CombinedRules come from configured datasources. Reasoned.
findings.reason: Minor, low production likelihood; settle by a test rendering RuleDetails for a CombinedRule whose rulesSource name is not registered. ponytail: new throw path in render hook, revisit if a removed/renamed datasource crash is reported.

findings.claim: Test coverage gap: RulesTable.test.tsx mocks every useAbilities hook including the new prom path (contrary to alerting TESTING.md, which prescribes enableRBAC/grantUserPermissions + MSW), so the OR-merge in AlertRuleMenu/RuleActionsButtons.V2, useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities and useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable are never exercised unmocked; GrafanaGroupLoader.test never clicks Silence/Duplicate. This is how the Duplicate and federated regressions slip through.
findings.evidence: RulesTable.test.tsx:20-29, 57-73 mock additions; useGrafanaPromRuleAbility mocks in Grafana Edit tests are no-ops because v1 RuleActionsButtons never calls it; public/app/features/alerting/unified/TESTING.md.
findings.reason: Addressed incidentally by the red tests for the accepted Important findings; ponytail: replacing the mock-heavy RulesTable setup is a separate refactor.
